{{Quote|How dare you invade my fortress and murder my courageous brothers-in-arms?|Dareg|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Dareg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was one of the leaders of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] and the head of the [[Separatist stronghold]] inside [[Mount Avilatan]], an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on [[Avilatan]] island, [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Dareg despised [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during [[Time/Legends|period]] of the [[Cold War]], Dareg's family inhereited a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] at some point. The droid contained records of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] legally owed to [[House Teraan]], a Royal family on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who lost the droid to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], though how much he knew about the droid's true nature is unclear. Dareg lived on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and grew disillusioned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] because of the corruption and what he felt was the oppression of the people of Ord Mantell. He joined the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] and would become a prominent leader of the Movement.

During the [[Separatist War]] Dareg would command a legion of troops in a [[Separatist stronghold]] established in the heart of [[Mount Avilatan]], which was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] was known to have secret dealings with [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]]; at one time Dareg scheduled a meeting with Skavak for the shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] originally intended for the [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]], while [[Syreena]] would warn Dareg of a [[Voidhound|smuggler]], who was after Skavak for a ship Skavak stole. Instead, Skavak betrayed him and his movement to steel the droid Dareg inherited, which bewildered [[Morant]], who had only been with Dareg a few months, as he considered the droid ancient and worthless. By the time the [[Voidhound|smuggler]] infiltrated the Separatist base and confronted Dareg and his men Skavak was already gone. Dareg attacked the smuggler in retaliation but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] instead, leaving Morant alive to tell where Skavak was instead. The smuggler would continue to pursue Skavak, but he fled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] could apprehend him.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Please, I swear to you I'll never serve a man like Dareg again.|Morant|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
A muscular Human with brown hair and eyes, Dareg held a fanatical view of the Separatist Movement, considering his members courageous "brothers in arms" and "executioners of justice" for the people of Ord Mantell that he felt were oppressed by their corrupt planetary government. [[Viidu]], on the other hand, considered him a psychopath.

Dareg wasn't willing to negotiate with the Smuggler for the location of Skavak because of the members killed that Morant felt would have been avoided if he just told the truth about Skavak's betrayal.

==Behind the scenes==
Dareg first appears in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a enemy Boss NPC as part of the Smuggler storyline that the player has to kill to proceed then talk to Morant.

Datamined dialogue reveals that Dareg would've expressed a different opening line if the Smuggler was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]], however Dareg doesn't express this line.
